content.text:
QQQ shorts did well today because QQQ opened 1.8% higher and then fell about 4.6% from its high. The regular session ended at **$645.04, down 2.19%**. My quote feed shows $641.82 (‑2.68%), but that includes after-hours trading.

I don't have trade-by-trade or short-seller position data, so I can't tell you who made which trades. Below are the 10 best shorts among QQQ's holdings today, ranked two ways.

### What happened

| | QQQ |
|---|---|
| Prior close (11/18) | $659.51 |
| Open | $671.09 (+1.8% gap up) |
| High / Low | $676.49 / $644.34 |
| Close | $645.04 (‑2.19%) |
| Volume | 69.5M (vs. 45.1M on 11/18) |

If you shorted at the open you made about 3.9% by the close. If you shorted at the high you made about 4.6%. QQQ is now about 11% below its Oct 21 close of $725.20.

### The rationale

1. **The morning rally was easy to sell.** Premarket buying was driven by Anthropic pricing its IPO at $83 and Nvidia's results ($130B revenue outlook). But Nvidia also announced a CEO search (Jensen Huang is out), and that was still hanging over AI stocks. The gap up didn't last.
2. **The Fed turned more hawkish.** Wednesday's minutes from the October meeting said almost all officials see more rate *increases* as likely. Governor Waller said a 50bp hike in December is possible. The next decision is Dec 9. Rate hikes hurt high-valuation tech the most.
3. **AMD was hit by a short-seller report.** Hunterbrook disclosed a short position and alleged AMD has its own China problem: firmware reaching blacklisted IEIT Systems, and over 20% of revenue billed to China and Hong Kong. AMD closed down 7.7% and says the claims "misrepresent" its business. This hurt the idea that AMD would gain from Nvidia's troubles, and dragged down the other chip stocks.
4. **The selling was broad.** Only 8 of about 97 Nasdaq-100 stocks rose. The S&P 500 had already fallen five days in a row.
5. **More shorts were already in place.** QQQ short interest rose from 64.3M shares (Aug 14) to 82.8M (Oct 30), so many shorts were already set up for this drop.

### Top 10 short trades by impact on QQQ (regular session)
Weights are rough, based on market cap alone. QQQ uses modified weights, so treat these as estimates.

| # | Ticker | Close | Day % | Mkt cap lost | ≈ QQQ drag |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | GOOGL | $272.66 | ‑3.46% | ‑$116B | ‑34 bp |
| 2 | NVDA | $145.98 | ‑3.30% | ‑$116B | ‑34 bp |
| 3 | AMZN | $257.37 | ‑3.87% | ‑$108B | ‑31 bp |
| 4 | MSFT | $498.30 | ‑1.97% | ‑$73B | ‑21 bp |
| 5 | AMD | $489.19 | ‑7.72% | ‑$61B | ‑18 bp |
| 6 | META | $596.22 | ‑3.27% | ‑$50B | ‑15 bp |
| 7 | AAPL | $349.21 | ‑0.92% | ‑$47B | ‑14 bp |
| 8 | TSLA | $374.41 | ‑2.43% | ‑$35B | ‑10 bp |
| 9 | AVGO | $346.65 | ‑2.09% | ‑$35B | ‑10 bp |
| 10 | MU | $690.44 | ‑2.10% | ‑$16B | ‑5 bp |

### Top 10 by % drop (regular session)
AMD ‑7.7%, TTD ‑6.2%, DASH ‑5.8%, SHOP ‑5.3%, MRVL ‑4.9%, MELI ‑4.8%, LULU ‑4.7%, MSTR ‑4.6%, CHTR ‑4.3%, SBUX ‑4.3%.

Micron gained about 3.9% premarket, then reversed to close down 2.1%. That's the same fade QQQ showed.

### After hours
- **INTU** is down about 9.7% after hours (closed ‑1.0%). It reported Q1 FY27 results above the top of its guidance (revenue +12%) and agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons.
- **ROST** is down about 8.1% after hours (closed ‑3.4%). It beat estimates: EPS $1.91 vs. $1.75–1.83 guidance, same-store sales +8%.

I didn't find why either stock is falling despite beating. Updated guidance is the likely reason, but I haven't confirmed it. Their drop, plus AMD and Micron each falling about another 2% after hours, explains the extra ~0.5% QQQ decline after the close.

Sources: Financial Datasets and Equibles prices, quotes and short interest; [CNBC on AMD](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/amd-falls-on-short-seller-report-of-alleged-china-exposure.html); [TradingView/PRN market recap](https://www.tradingview.com/news/prnewswire:2a19ae2c676ab:0-five-straight-losses-one-divergence-where-the-major-indexes-stand-now/); [Moomoo premarket note](https://www.moomoo.com/community/feed/qqq-gains-premarket-as-put-call-ratio-falls-close-to-117642511253510); ROST and INTU 8-Ks filed 11/19 ([ROST](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/745732/000074573226000047/q326exhibit991.htm), [INTU](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687826000043/fy27q1earningspressrelease.htm)).
